{{Top|leg}}
'''Nilos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] and member of the [[InterStellar Regulators]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]] in [[3638 BBY]], the Regulators sided with the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] in their occupation of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Under orders of [[Vice-Commandant]] [[Grevin]], Nilos and his men shuffled citizens of Makeb between several secure locations in [[Talaos City]] to prevent them from organizing against the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. Nilos questioned the nature of the order, but Grevin reminded the sergeant that keeping the Hutts happy was what paid his salary, threatening to place him on cleaning duty if he continued to object.<ref name="Cattle">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|Civilian Cattle Call|[[Makeb]]}}</ref>
